description: Source code for a Zephyr-based MQTT-SN UDP client, implementing connection handling, event processing, and periodic publishing in a separate thread.

methods.name: evt_cb
methods.description: Callback function handling MQTT-SN client events such as connection, disconnection, sleep, wake, publish, and ping response.

methods.name: do_work
methods.description: Performs periodic input processing, manages subscriptions, and publishes timestamp data if connected.

methods.name: process_thread
methods.description: Thread function that initializes UDP transport, connects MQTT-SN client, and runs the main loop.

methods.name: start_thread
methods.description: Function to initialize and start the UDP thread, including setting thread name and joining.
